changes: Resolved the actual upstream merge in an isolated worktree, preserving the original user checkout.
Native authority bootstrap reads canonical locks; Wasm retains the regenerated compact projection. VE-38 regression fails on the prior stale projection.
The authority Wasm export uses the existing global bridge mutex.
RNG seed normalization is equivalent to seed | 1 and is admitted by Prism lifting; 65,792 seed cases cover the low word and every bit position.

StorageBlock is grounded in the existing model ratchet. Decoder register widths, dispatch and stores derive from constructive scalar constants and machine types. No tensor arithmetic fallback or generated library edit.
